## About
Capstone Auto Body Parts is an auto body parts distributor on Roxburgh Dr in Houston. We carry aftermarket replacement parts from Acura to Volvo, and our warehouse is stocked for collision repair shops and for anyone fixing their own car or truck.
We are proud members of the ABPA. Customers have rated us 4.3 from 116 Google reviews, and longtime shop accounts mention our staff, our pricing and the size of our inventory.

## Services
- Exterior body parts and lights: Exterior body parts and lights for most models of domestic and foreign cars and trucks.
- Radiators, condensers and cooling fans: Radiators, air conditioning condensers and cooling fans.
- Greater Houston Metropolitan area: We ship to locations within the greater Houston Metropolitan area.

## FAQ
Q: Do you sell to the public or only to body shops?
A: Both. Our warehouse is stocked for the collision repair industry and for the general public.

Q: What if the part I need isn't in stock?
A: Next day service is usually available when a part isn't in stock at the time you order.

Q: What is your return policy?
A: Authorized returns must be undamaged and in the original packing, within 15 days of the purchase date.
